claim_scope: One G1 hands-on-back tracking clip in Isaac Lab, the named SONIC architecture and optimizer, 1024 training environments, a 1500-iteration warm-start budget, and the frozen 512-replicate evaluation panel.
independent_unit: solved origin policy plus continuation-training seed

D1_push_practice_is_productive.rule: both new-seed deltas > 0 and their mean >= 5 points

D2_selecting_push_beats_manageable_place.rule: both new-seed deltas > 0 and mean >= 5 points; |mean| < 2 is only the frozen screen band

not_claimed: statistical significance or population-level equivalence from three seeds
a universal property of push disturbances outside the named simulator, policy, clip, dose, and budget
practice utility from a capability probe
